summary_en: Annual dividend increased to 42 yen/share from prior 30 yen/share (+40%). Interim dividend raised to 24 yen/share from 12 yen/share, incorporating 12 yen/share 70th anniversary special commemoration. Year-end dividend held at 18 yen/share. Driven by upside earnings revision: FY27/3 net profit lifted 179% to 6,000M yen on semiconductor memory market strength and HBM/SSD demand surge.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Increase) for FY3/27
translation_en_brief: Minato Holdings announced on 10 August 2026 a revision of its FY3/27 dividend forecast (fiscal year ending 31 March 2027). The annual dividend per share is being raised to 42 yen from the previously guided 30 yen, a 40% increase. The interim dividend is being doubled from 12 yen to 24 yen per share—the increase includes a 12 yen special commemorative dividend marking the company's 70th anniversary (to be observed 17 December 2026). The year-end dividend remains unchanged at 18 yen per share. The hike is supported by an upside revision to full-year net profit attributable to parent shareholders, which has been lifted 179% to 6,000 million yen (from the prior forecast of 2,150 million yen), driven by strength in the semiconductor memory market, particularly demand for advanced memory such as HBM and SSDs for generative AI data centers. The company states that profit growth will moderate from Q2 onward as inventory-driven sales benefits taper, but management is maintaining the dividend increase while balancing future capital investment and financial soundness.
